assets.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Create one original high-resolution photographic material plate for an editorial science animation, landscape 3:2. Extreme macro, straight-on polished cut face of Roman-inspired lime-and-volcanic-aggregate concrete. Frame filled edge to edge with warm charcoal taupe mortar, convincing angular small basalt aggregate, gritty mineral pores, a conspicuous irregular chalk-white lime inclusion centered at 55 percent width and 50 percent height. The white inclusion about 12 percent of the image width. Several smaller pale inclusions elsewhere. Dry material, uniform restrained side illumination, sharp real granular microtexture, no cast exterior shadow, no text, no diagram, no arrows, no ruler, no objects or background. This is an explicitly illustrative material asset, not an archaeological sample. Keep it uncracked so an authored annotation can introduce and close a schematic crack through the central white inclusion. Premium natural-history editorial macro photograph aesthetic.

assets.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. One original natural-history photographic-style isolated pistol shrimp (Alpheus type) cutout, side view, facing RIGHT, transparent background. Landscape 3:2 composition. Whole small marine shrimp, olive amber translucent segmented carapace, anatomically plausible walking legs and antennae, one conspicuously enlarged snapper claw extended to the right; small other claw subordinate. Large snapper claw open, clear two-part pincer anatomy and a visible hinge, with its outlet near the rightmost claw end. Long narrow abdomen curls slightly toward the LEFT and tail fan at far left; eye stalk and head face right. Large claw occupies the right third of the picture and remains inside frame; whole subject has generous transparent clearance. Natural documentary macro detail and material richness, carefully cut-out fine legs, no cast shadow, no sea floor, no water, no bubbles, no glow, no labels, no arrows, no title. This is an illustrative specimen, not research footage; no stylized cartoon geometry. Intended animation inspects this exact claw, then constructs a separately labeled jet/bubble explanation in code.

assets.text: Some Roman concrete repairs itself. Water enters a crack, dissolves calcium from lime fragments, and new mineral deposits can seal the gap.
These islands are neighbors. But the International Date Line runs between them. Cross that boundary, and the calendar date changes.
This shrimp's snap comes from a collapsing bubble. Its claw fires a water jet. The bubble forms, then implodes.
This lake is underwater. Extra salt makes its brine denser than seawater, so it settles into a depression on the seafloor.
